# Set-ZbxHostGroup

## SYNOPSIS

Changes a host group.

## SYNTAX

```
Set-ZbxHostGroup [-InputObject] <ZabbixReference<ZabbixHostGroup>[]> [[-Name] <string>] [-Uuid <string>] [-AdditionalProperty <Hashtable>] [-Force] [-PassThru] [-PipedRecord <PSObject>] [-Connection <ZabbixConnection>] [-WhatIf] [-Confirm] [<CommonParameters>]
```

## DESCRIPTION

A host group is a named set of hosts; permissions, maintenance periods, actions and frontend views select hosts by their groups. The Set-ZbxHostGroup cmdlet changes the host groups given to -InputObject (names, ids or piped objects) with hostgroup.update; a field whose parameter is not given keeps its value. Every host group the pipeline brings is changed in one call when the pipeline ends, and -AdditionalProperty sets any other field by its API name. The command writes nothing unless -PassThru is given, which reads the changed host groups back and writes them; -WhatIf shows what would change.

## EXAMPLES

### Example 1: Rename a host group

```powershell
Set-ZbxHostGroup 'Web servers' 'Web servers (production)' -PassThru | Select-Object GroupId, Name
```

-InputObject (position 0) is the group and -Name (position 1) its new name; hosts, permissions and actions follow.

### Example 2: Preview renaming a group

```powershell
Set-ZbxHostGroup -InputObject 'Linux servers' -Name 'Linux servers (production)' -WhatIf
```

-WhatIf names the group the command would change, and changes nothing.

## INPUTS

- `ZabbixReference<ZabbixHostGroup>[]`: Bound to -InputObject (ByValue). Represents a reference to an API object: a parameter that points at an API object takes its id, its name, or the object itself piped from a Get- cmdlet, and becomes an id before the call — one parameter, three spellings, one resolution.
- `string`: Bound to -Uuid (ByPropertyName), -Name (ByPropertyName). Text.
- `PSObject`: Bound to -PipedRecord (ByValue). Each object as the API answers it.
